al_islands_the.blurb: The Islands is a cluster of freestanding sandstone formations at the far southwest end of Sand Rock, the county park above Cherokee Rock Village in northeast Alabama. Most of the twelve climbs are bolted sport lines, with a single trad route mixed in. The lower slabs are short, around 30 feet, while the taller lines on the bigger formations reach roughly 100 feet. Grades run from the 5.8 range up to 5.12, with the bulk of the routes sitting at 5.11, so this is more a spot for stronger climbers than for beginners. Expect a short walk past West Side Rock from the main pinnacle area, and a scramble up a corridor to reach the tops.
